summary: Backend regression tests for the new Scope 3 Bulk Upload System (15 categories, C1-C15). Verified template generation, upload validation, fuzzy matching, C7 aggregation, C15 supplier-only restriction, supplier-basis custom activities, jobs listing/pagination/details, and error report download. All 19 tests passed (100%) against https://completion-engine-v2.preview.emergentagent.com/api/bulk-upload/scope3.

minor.issue: Two helper sheet names exceed Excel's 31-char limit (e.g. '_ActivityTypes' is fine, but openpyxl emits a UserWarning 'Title is more than 31 characters. Some applications may not be able to read the file' for category sheets like 'C3 - Fuel and Energy Related Activities' (40 chars), 'C5 - Waste Generated in Operations' (34), 'C10 - Processing of Sold Products' (33), 'C13 - Downstream Leased Assets' (30 ok), 'C9 - Downstream Transportation' (30 ok). MS Excel still opens the file, but Numbers/older clients may truncate. Consider shortening sheet names to <=31 chars for full cross-app compatibility.

action_items: (Optional) Shorten Scope 3 template sheet names to <=31 chars to silence openpyxl warning and ensure broader Excel-client compatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at lines 7585-7770 duplicates the entire Scope 3 bulk upload router that already exists at /app/backend/bulk_upload_scope3/router.py. The standalone router module is imported but never wired in (server.py builds an inline duplicate APIRouter instead). This violates DRY: any future change must be made in two places. Recommend importing `from bulk_upload_scope3.router import router as scope3_router` and using `api_router.include_router(scope3_router)` after binding the dependency overrides for `get_db` and `get_current_user`.
/app/backend/server.py is now 7812 lines — far above the 700-line guideline. Bulk-upload endpoints should be moved out (the dedicated router module is already there).

bulk_upload_scope3/router.py (lines 17-25) defines `get_db` / `get_current_user` placeholders that raise NotImplementedError; if a future developer wires this router directly, these placeholders aren't overridden, which would 500 every request. Consider injecting them via a `setup_router(db, get_user)` factory like the rest of the codebase.

router.py upload_file (line 60) and server.py upload endpoint both wrap UploadProcessor.process_upload in try/except that re-raises as 500. This swallows pydantic validation errors and returns a generic message — preferable to log the traceback and let FastAPI's exception handlers map known exceptions.

Reporting-month parser (validators/base_validator.py line 62-98) accepts 'Jan-2025', 'January 2025', '2025-01', '01/2025' — but template column header advertises 'MMM-YYYY' format only. UI/template tooltip should match what the validator actually accepts to reduce user confusion.

C15 sheet declares supported_methods including only supplier_basis (validated). However, the inline mandatory-field check still defines spend_basis/activity_basis keys for some other categories — verify all 15 mandatory_fields blocks list only supported methods to avoid misleading downstream callers.
